d: Deep Narayan Singh was appointed as a caretaker Chief Minister of Bihar in 1961 when Shri Krishna Singh, the former Chief Minister, died in harness. His tenure as a caretaker of Chief Minister was of 17 days. On 31 January 1961, the first Chief Minister of Bihar Shri Krishna Singh died. At that time, the Governor of Bihar was educationist Dr Zakir Hussain, who later became the President of the country. They had a strange crisis.
